method: Full Alpaca operating-company universe -> resilient snapshot discovery without treating missing premarket quote/volume as illiquidity -> up to 20,000-stock pre-history tournament using every legitimate active/tradable operating-company candidate available -> every discovered stock daily-history analysis (up to 20,000) with 20-day average dollar-volume liquidity verification -> every discovered stock setup-specific BREAKOUT/PULLBACK/TREND validation -> strongest qualified names into Teststock optimizer. Live spread is always re-verified at execution.
